summary: PulseGuard v0.6.15 makes manual driver scans responsive, corrects Windows driver-ranking interpretation, removes false missing-driver states, and compacts the Dashboard/Optimize layouts to use screen space more effectively.

sections.heading: SCAN DRIVERS no longer freezes the window
sections.detail: The complete manual driver scan now runs in a responsive background worker, including Device Manager health, signed-driver inventory, Windows Update checks, and trusted OEM/Microsoft Catalog discovery. Scan and install buttons are mutually disabled while a driver worker is active.

sections.heading: INSTALL DRIVER UPDATES is clearer
sections.detail: The old INSTALL WU DRIVERS label is now INSTALL DRIVER UPDATES because PulseGuard can use verified Windows Update, OEM, and Microsoft Catalog driver lanes while retaining signature, hardware-match, downgrade, BIOS, reboot, and safety protections.

sections.heading: Windows driver ranking is handled correctly
sections.detail: PnPUtil ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS (259) on a healthy device is treated as Windows keeping the preferred current driver rather than an install failure. Exact rank-rejected candidates are remembered and are not repeatedly advertised as actionable while the installed version and candidate remain unchanged.

sections.heading: False missing-driver counts removed
sections.detail: Missing metadata in Win32_PnPSignedDriver is now informational. Only Device Manager Code 28 marks a device as actually needing a driver, while other non-zero Device Manager codes remain separate device problems.

sections.heading: Dashboard and Optimize layouts are tighter
sections.detail: The Dashboard heartbeat is now a thin footer so Findings, Recommended Actions, and Quick Actions receive more vertical space. Optimize compacts the process/changes deck, expands Changes Recorded into the formerly unused right side, and moves the live details panel upward.

sections.heading: Normal Game Ready partial safety decisions are informational
sections.detail: When some child processes are safely closed and others are intentionally kept by policy, the consolidated PARTIAL decision is logged as information rather than a warning.
